entries.title: Theme admin list showing Nonprofit.
entries.notes: Capture with Foundation Theme, Layout Builder, and capell-app/theme-nonprofit installed in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator confirms the Nonprofit theme is available for charity, campaign, and civic sites.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with Nonprofit theme.
entries.notes: Capture a seeded cause page with campaigns, impact, volunteer/donate CTA, events, stories, contact, proof, and footer.
entries.useCase: A charity or civic team sees how the theme moves visitors from understanding to support.

entries.title: Nonprofit homepage.
entries.notes: Capture campaign hero, impact proof, donation/volunteer actions, and a calm civic visual rhythm.
entries.useCase: A nonprofit buyer reviews whether the first viewport creates trust and a clear support path.

entries.title: Campaigns and appeals.
entries.notes: Capture appeal cards, progress indicators, urgency copy, and supporter CTAs.
entries.useCase: A charity checks that campaign pages are more specific than broad landing pages.

entries.title: Impact evidence.
entries.notes: Capture impact metrics, evidence cards, story links, and reporting-friendly proof sections.
entries.useCase: A cause-led organisation can show outcomes without turning the theme into Corporate reporting.

entries.title: Volunteer and donate.
entries.notes: Capture parallel donation and volunteer pathways with accessible CTAs and form-builder fallback state.
entries.useCase: A visitor can choose a practical support route without losing the donation path.

entries.title: Community events.
entries.notes: Capture event cards using static fallback or capell-app/events integration when installed.
entries.useCase: A civic team can promote events and volunteering opportunities with the same theme language.

entries.title: Supporter and beneficiary stories.
entries.notes: Capture story cards, image treatment, campaign relationship, and next support actions.
entries.useCase: A nonprofit can use human proof without drifting into Portfolio's case-study presentation.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a signed preview URL generated for the seeded Nonprofit theme, site, and page.
entries.useCase: An administrator previews a campaign page with the Nonprofit theme applied before publishing the theme choice.
